common_view_sql: SELECT *,CAST(payload_00%17 AS DOUBLE) AS double_a,CAST(payload_01%17 AS DOUBLE) AS double_b,(payload_02%3=0) AS bool_a,(payload_03%5=0) AS bool_b,(payload_04%7=0) AS bool_c,ABS(payload_05%4096) AS in_key,CAST(l_shipdate AS VARCHAR) AS date_text,CAST(l_extendedprice AS VARCHAR) AS decimal_text,CASE WHEN l_orderkey%97=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(CAST(l_shipdate AS VARCHAR),1,4),'-2-9') END AS parser_date_input,CASE WHEN l_orderkey%97=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE CONCAT(CAST(l_shipdate AS VARCHAR),' 12:34:56') END AS parser_timestamp_input,CASE WHEN l_orderkey%97=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE CONCAT(CAST(l_linenumber AS VARCHAR),' months') END AS parser_year_month_input,CASE WHEN l_orderkey%97=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE CONCAT(CAST(l_linenumber AS VARCHAR),' days 2 hours') END AS parser_day_time_input,CASE WHEN l_orderkey%97=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) ELSE CONCAT(CAST(l_linenumber AS VARCHAR),' months 1 day 2 seconds') END AS parser_calendar_input FROM raw_lineitem

dimension.name: suppliers
dimension.recipe: suppkey=1..10000 BIGINT; region=suppkey%5 INT; label=supplier-{suppkey} STRING

queries.native_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_date_input AS DATE) AS result FROM bench
queries.spark_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_date_input AS DATE) AS result FROM bench

queries.native_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,ARROW_CAST(parser_timestamp_input,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))') AS result FROM bench
queries.spark_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_timestamp_input AS TIMESTAMP) AS result FROM bench

queries.native_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,ARROW_CAST(parser_timestamp_input,'Timestamp(Microsecond, None)') AS result FROM bench
queries.spark_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_timestamp_input AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS result FROM bench
SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_year_month_input AS INTERVAL YEAR TO MONTH) AS result FROM bench
SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_day_time_input AS INTERVAL DAY TO SECOND) AS result FROM bench
SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,CAST(parser_calendar_input AS INTERVAL) AS result FROM bench

queries.native_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,TO_CHAR(ARROW_CAST(parser_timestamp_input,'Timestamp(Microsecond, Some("UTC"))'),'%Y/%m/%d %H:%M') AS result FROM bench
queries.spark_sql: SELECT l_orderkey,l_linenumber,DATE_FORMAT(parser_timestamp_input,'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm') AS result FROM bench

input_columns.parser_calendar_input: CONCAT(CAST(l_linenumber AS VARCHAR),' months 1 day 2 seconds')
